_comment: b1 #199 'The Chieftain's Price'. Opens the quest and carries all three resolution paths (SUPPLY item / BROKER gold / FIGHT betrayal). Voice contract: docs/design/character-profiles.md#rags -- early-volume Rags, 1-4 word utterances, no articles. Costs follow the witch pattern: SUPPLY consumes a 10g draught, BROKER charges 6g, FIGHT is the betrayal close (start_combat on end). Back-out exit stays free and ungated (softlock guard). The two PEACEFUL first-contact options also bank chatted_with_rags, the met counter her inn-guest row needs: she has no npc entity anywhere (this graph hangs off the rags_scouting_party ENCOUNTER), so the usual talk_pool producer cannot exist for her. Deliberately NOT on '(Draw steel.)': the encounter's on_victory banks rags_meeting_settled, so without the split a betrayal win would satisfy the guest gate and seat the Chieftain you drove off.

hub.speaker: Rags
hub.text: You. The one who didn't kill.

text_variants.text: Good trade. Plains quiet. Go safe.
Winter came. Camp ate. Go safe.

options._comment: v0.16 F1 offer. TRAP: APPENDED LAST because rags_meeting_loop's settled guard clicks visible option 1 blind -- every new row sits below the ungated exit. hide_when is SINGLE-KEY (it is AND across keys).
options.text: Winter's coming. What does the camp need?

ask.speaker: Rags
ask._comment: The problem beat: wounded tribe, Watch sweep. She trades, never begs — offers the carved piece FIRST.
ask.text: Watch came. Goblins hurt. Not begging.

price.speaker: Rags
price._comment: She holds up a carved chess pawn — her own work. FIRST visit only names the price (multi-stage rule: the settle lives behind a leave-and-return through the hub's 'About the medicine.'; the Invrisil one-visit shape is the named mistake).

sealed.speaker: Rags
sealed._comment: Close beat. The Erin chess nod — smallest possible thaw, no fluency.
sealed.text: Good trade. Inn Human plays chess. Tell her: Rags wins next one.

settle.speaker: Rags
settle._comment: Second-visit settle node. BROKER's between-visits fiction is now literal: the player left, arranged goods with Liscor coin, returned. Draw-steel here carries no settle bank — the betrayal resolves via the encounter's on_victory (win-only; lose/flee leaves the quest open).

options.text: (Hand over the trade goods — 6 gold's worth, arranged in Liscor.)

winter.speaker: Rags
winter.text: Winter comes. Camp thin. Ask once.

text_variants.text: Carts came. Gnoll kept quiet. Good.

options.text: Krshia's carts are moving south for you.
Your racks are full. I carried what I could.
The scavengers won't press that ground again.

winter_ways.speaker: Rags
winter_ways._comment: TRAP: three SEPARATE report rungs above, one per route counter -- requires.accomplishment is AND across keys, so one row naming all three would demand all three.
winter_ways.text: Two ways. Gnoll moves goods. Hunters need hands. No, three. Scavengers press hollow.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.

winter_where.speaker: Rags
winter_where.text: South. Cut in turf. Two stones. Walk in, no steel.

winter_kept.speaker: Rags
winter_kept.text: Price kept. Goblins remember. Longer than Humans.
